$Comment: The Grit Oiler (DESIGN.md 6.2, 7.6; Gibson round 2 note 27): one in four. Rusted and blackened, sparking, gritty oil dripping. Its oil hurts the Heartwinder: 300 real damage (an effect DamageCalculator, so the hurt shows and the bar drops) and a 1 s jam marker the boss answers with a 3 s seize (sparks, a grinding bang, +25% damage taken). The encounter then shows the players "Grit in the gears!". Let it through.
